en.badge.title: Auto-snapshot status; click to open
en.boot.alert: ⚠️ Previous DSH run exited abnormally — roll back to the last good state
en.boot.crash.bundle: Likely a profile-bundle hard-check failure — enable SAFE MODE and restart DSH
en.boot.crash.patch: Likely a plugin mount/load failure — roll back to a recent good snapshot
en.boot.crash.session: Likely session-file damage — run undo_scan (quarantine=true) in chat/CLI, or offline dsh-undo.ps1 scan --fix
en.boot.rollback: Roll back to last good state
en.err.busy: A session is running (agent in progress). Undo/redo would interrupt every session; wait for the task to finish or interrupt it first, then retry.
en.export.sensitive.warn: ⚠️ This archive contains REAL secrets (.env / .credentials.yaml in keep mode or legacy snapshots) — do NOT share it!
en.keys.hint: Click the box then press a combo; Backspace clears; defaults Ctrl+Alt+Z / Ctrl+Alt+Y
en.msg.title: Message-level undo
en.panel.confirm.delete: Delete this snapshot? This cannot be undone.
en.panel.confirm.restore: Restore to this snapshot? Current state is kept as a redo point.
en.panel.diff.title: Diff preview
en.panel.empty: No snapshots yet. Config changes auto-archive; or click Save now.
en.panel.title: Snapshot Manager
en.restart.required: Rolled back. A DSH restart is required for the restored state to take effect.
en.safe.off.confirm: Exit SAFE MODE? The full plugin set from before safe mode will be restored. Takes effect after a DSH restart.
en.safe.on.confirm: Enable SAFE MODE? All user plugins except the undo system will be temporarily disabled, and profile bundles that would prevent DSH from booting will be neutralized (a snapshot and config backups are taken first). Takes effect after a DSH restart.
en.settings.cleanupNote: Auto keeps {keepAuto}, pre-restore keeps {keepPre}; manual snapshots are never deleted; disabling auto-cleanup keeps everything
en.settings.schedule.hint: Auto-snapshot on a timer, interval ≥1 min; disabled means only config changes auto-snapshot
en.settings.sensitive.redact: Redact (default: values become ***REDACTED***, local rollback restores fully)
en.settings.title: Snapshot Settings
en.settings.workspaceDirs.hint: Comma/semicolon separated (multi-select); when non-empty it REPLACES the default current-dir scope; leave empty = current dir only
en.snapshots.aria: Save a snapshot of the current config now
